SELECT status, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT web_order_id) d, min(order_ts_utc) mn, max(order_ts_utc) mx
FROM fact_web_order
WHERE order_ts_utc >= '2025-11-30 20:00' AND order_ts_utc < '2025-12-02 04:00'
GROUP BY 1

WITH o AS (
 SELECT web_order_id, status, order_ts_utc, CAST((order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Helsinki' AS DATE) hel_date, CAST(order_ts_utc AS DATE) utc_date
 FROM fact_web_order WHERE order_ts_utc >= '2025-11-30 00:00' AND order_ts_utc < '2025-12-03')
SELECT hel_date, utc_date, status, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT web_order_id) d FROM o GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2,3

calls.statement:
WITH o AS (
 SELECT web_order_id, status, fulfilment_type, CAST((order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Helsinki' AS DATE) hel_date
 FROM fact_web_order),
l AS (SELECT receipt_id, min(sale_date) sd, max(sale_date) sd2, count(*) n, max(channel_id) ch FROM fact_sales_line WHERE channel_id IN (2,3) GROUP BY 1)
SELECT o.status, (l.receipt_id IS NULL) no_lines, l.sd = o.hel_date same_date, count(*) c
FROM o LEFT JOIN l ON l.receipt_id=o.web_order_id
WHERE o.hel_date='2025-12-01' OR l.sd='2025-12-01'
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2,3

SELECT 'stg' src, status, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT web_order_id) d, sum(CASE WHEN web_order_id IN (SELECT web_order_id FROM fact_web_order) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) in_fact
FROM stg_web_order_load WHERE CAST((order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Helsinki' AS DATE)='2025-12-01' GROUP BY ALL
UNION ALL
SELECT 'fact', login_state||'/'||fulfilment_type, count(*), count(DISTINCT web_order_id), sum(CASE WHEN line_count IS NULL OR line_count=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
FROM fact_web_order WHERE CAST((order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Helsinki' AS DATE)='2025-12-01' AND status<>'cancelled' GROUP BY ALL
